en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, ornate corner palace-style building with mansard roof and rich Neo-Renaissance/Neo-Baroque details, labeled as Dr. Löwy's palace. Trees and a paved street surround the building. Hungarian text appears below the image and along the left margin. The reverse side is blank and printed with Hungarian words for postcard and address lines.
